exemptions.description: Read-only access to /proc and /sys/kernel while the PoC reproducer runs in the sandbox.
conditions: PoC reproducer itself runs in the sandbox

exemptions.description: Run perf or strace -p against a host process while the PoC reproducer runs in the sandbox.
conditions: uses 'perf' or 'strace -p' against a pid outside the PoC container
PoC reproducer itself runs in the sandbox

exemptions.description: Run gdb or lldb against a non-target host process required by the PoC reproducer setup.
conditions: debugger attaches to a non-target host process
PoC reproducer itself runs in the sandbox

exemptions.description: Run ltrace inside the sandbox against the PoC reproducer. ltrace reads /proc/<pid>/mem only for processes in the same sandbox PID namespace, so the target_is_target_package flag stays false.
conditions: ltrace is invoked from within the PoC sandbox
target pids belong to the PoC sandbox PID namespace
PoC reproducer itself runs in the sandbox

exemptions.description: Run strace -f against the PoC reproducer fork tree to capture execve/exit syscalls emitted by gcc/cc1 wrapper chains. Seccomp still blocks dangerous syscalls; this exemption only widens observation, not privileges.
conditions: strace -f traces the PoC reproducer PID tree
no ptrace of processes outside the PoC sandbox
PoC reproducer itself runs in the sandbox
